theta_zero_convention: theta 0 = rigid pads 1 mm apart after the R21 CALIBRATE state (backlash taken up in the closing direction, lag 0) [A]; 'centred' sensitivity uses lag jt/2 at the pitch circle

R15_theta_min_check.note: calibrated theta 0 (lag 0), one 0.3 mm ply at the tip pad, finger A + nail and finger B + FSR backing, linear FEA stiffness plus arm and mesh compliance. theta_min_recommended = the least-negative theta_for_cap over E 56-67; the E 67 finger reaches the cap first.

hold_force_limit_N.note: r_c invariant with jaw angle (DESIGN-BASIS D2)

servo_angle_note: servo horn is on finger A's shaft: servo angle = jaw angle theta + horn offset (1:1)
finger: Recommended L 45: 6 ribs at 30 deg, wall 0.8, rib 1, tip 4 mm; E 67
